hasGeyserMarkers() returns false, so ParseTransaction cannot enter its advertised Geyser branch; the dormant Geyser decoder also initializes empty instruction/account collections.

model creation, multiple trades, inner instructions, and migration as independent parsed events

risks: The source README also describes transaction sending; do not run those tests or invoke any signing/submission path.
An unreferenced demonstration helper fabricates a sample swap from arbitrary long input.
No LICENSE file is present in the reviewed repository root; license remains unverified.
